clue.text: Helping to cover the Spanish family member

indicators.note: one piece is said to cover the other, so it wraps around it on both sides

parts.note: a helping is a portion or ration of food
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: Someone helps shield a Spanish relative from trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Helping' reads as a verb (assisting), but here it is the noun for a portion of food.
explanation.definitionFit: A relative by blood or marriage is a member of one's family.

clue.text: Bacon more reckless?

explanation.surface: Is bacon more daring?
explanation.definitionFit: A slice of bacon has this name; it is also the comparative of rash, meaning more hasty.

clue.text: Boy blushing about climbing gear

parts.note: a lad is a boy

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: blushing means red-faced

explanation.surface: A lad goes red over his mountaineering equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of rungs used for going up is equipment for climbing.

clue.text: Roman singer who loved painter from Ascot

indicators.note: the answer is made from the letters of the next word, rearranged

explanation.surface: An Italian vocalist fell for an artist from the racecourse town of Ascot.
explanation.walkthrough: Puccini's heroine Floria Tosca is a singer in Rome who loves the painter Cavaradossi; ASCOT is an English racecourse town.
explanation.definitionFit: In Puccini's opera the title heroine is a Roman diva in love with an artist.

clue.text: Bull gets on with Ian, a university man

parts.note: an ox is a bovine animal like a bull
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A bull gets along with Ian, a student.
explanation.definitionFit: An Oxonian is a member or graduate of Oxford University.

clue.text: Duo sit awkwardly in workroom

indicators.note: something done awkwardly is clumsy and out of order, so these letters get rearranged

explanation.surface: Two people perch uncomfortably in a workshop.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's or broadcaster's studio is a room where work is done.

clue.text: Support for acrobat stoned on hemp, perhaps

parts.note: tight is slang for drunk, as is stoned
hemp fibre is used to make rope

explanation.surface: An acrobat's prop is a performer high on cannabis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stoned on hemp' suggests drugs, but stoned means drunk (TIGHT) and hemp is a rope fibre.
explanation.definitionFit: A taut wire or cable held high is what a circus walker balances on.

clue.text: Between start and finish of day posh car provides fun

indicators.note: one piece sits between two letters, which wrap around it
the first and last letters of the word

parts.note: a Roller is slang for a Rolls-Royce

explanation.surface: Fun comes from a luxury car between dawn and dusk.
explanation.definitionFit: Drollery is dry humour, an amusing quality.

clue.text: Several balls finished over the top

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls
done means finished

explanation.surface: Bowling six balls is overdoing it.
explanation.walkthrough: An OVER in cricket is a sequence of six balls bowled from one end.
explanation.definitionFit: Something exaggerated or excessive is overplayed.

clue.text: Team has to appear in minor event

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
to show up is to appear

explanation.surface: A team is obliged to turn up at some lesser fixture.
explanation.definitionFit: A sideshow is a small attraction or subsidiary happening beside the main one.

clue.text: Take no notice of damaged groin and start to exercise

indicators.note: something damaged is knocked out of shape, so these letters are rearranged
the start of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: An athlete is told to disregard a groin strain and begin training.
explanation.definitionFit: To disregard something is to pay it no attention.

clue.text: Working with United States is a burden

parts.note: a machine that is on is working
US is the United States

explanation.surface: Collaborating with America is a heavy load.
explanation.definitionFit: An onus is a responsibility or duty, a weight one carries.

clue.text: Promotion is part of architect's plan

definitions.meaning: raising someone to a higher rank or post
a drawing showing one face of a building

explanation.surface: A rise in rank is part of what an architect has drawn up.
explanation.definitionFit: Being raised in rank is an upgrade; an architect's side view drawing of a facade carries the same name.

clue.text: It reversed and went in front covered with thin slabs

indicators.note: the word is turned so it is read from right to left

parts.note: to lead is to go in front; led is its past tense

explanation.surface: Something backed up and then took the lead.
explanation.definitionFit: A roof or floor covered with ceramic squares has been tiled.

clue.text: Flatten metal

definitions.meaning: to press creases out of clothes

explanation.surface: Squash the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressing laundry smooth uses the same word as the element Fe, a common metal.

clue.text: Adjust when back on the prairie

parts.note: the rear is the back
a range is open grazing land like a prairie

explanation.surface: Someone makes changes on returning home on the prairie.
explanation.definitionFit: To reorder or alter the positions of things is to adjust them.

clue.text: Pros ran off with setter's purse

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong or out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Professionals made off with the compiler's wallet.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter is Highlander, so his purse is the pouch worn in front of a Scottish kilt.
explanation.definitionFit: A sporran is the leather pouch worn with Highland dress, fitting a setter called Highlander.

clue.text: Confessed publicity timed badly — and about time

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement, publicity

indicators.note: one piece goes about the other, surrounding it
something done badly is muddled, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone owned up that the advert went out at the wrong time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts the scrambled TIMED (here MITED) around T.
explanation.definitionFit: To have admitted a fault is to have owned up to it.

clue.text: Facade of building in promenade period

parts.note: the front is the seaside promenade
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A building's face stands on the seafront in a past era.
explanation.definitionFit: The frontage is the face of a building looking onto a street.

clue.text: Big bedroom insect is hibernating

parts.note: a dorm or dormitory is a large shared bedroom
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: Some insect in a large bedroom has gone into its winter sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: A creature sleeping through winter is inactive, in a resting state.

clue.text: Man's jug

definitions.meaning: a beer mug shaped like a seated man in a tricorn hat

explanation.surface: A man's jug.
explanation.definitionFit: Toby is a masculine name, and a Toby jug is a pottery drinking vessel modelled as a figure.

clue.text: Gang of workmen made squawking noises

definitions.meaning: crowed, as a cock does; an old past tense of crow

explanation.surface: Labourers were squawking.
explanation.definitionFit: A team of workers is a squad; the old past tense of crow, as a cockerel does, has the same spelling.

clue.text: Severely criticise clothes and accessories

explanation.surface: Tear apart someone's outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: To clobber is to hammer someone; in British slang the word also means one's gear or kit.

clue.text: Expedition from South Island, covering a great distance

indicators.note: one piece covers the other, sitting on both sides of it

parts.note: far means a great distance away

explanation.surface: A trip from the South Island of New Zealand covering many miles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'South Island' reads as New Zealand's island, but it is S and I split to hold A FAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A safari is an overland trip, especially to see wild animals.

clue.text: Grab hold of eggs

definitions.meaning: a set of eggs laid at one time

explanation.surface: Seize the eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: To clutch is to grip; a brood of eggs laid together is also called a clutch.

clue.text: Victor loses wicket and part of target

indicators.note: the piece named after it is dropped from the word

parts.note: a victor is a winner
W is the cricket abbreviation for wicket

explanation.surface: The champion gives up a wicket and some of the target.
explanation.definitionFit: On an archery or darts board the ring next to the bull is the inner.

clue.text: Reserves big booth for selling printed matter

parts.note: to book is to reserve
tall means big in height

explanation.surface: Someone reserves a large kiosk for selling newspapers.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand selling books and papers, as at a station, is a kind of booth.

clue.text: Home Counties can become established

parts.note: the Home Counties around London lie in the South East, SE
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: The counties around London may become settled.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the English counties surrounding London, in the South East (SE).
explanation.definitionFit: When a condition sets in, it takes hold and becomes settled.

clue.text: Transport using coaches

definitions.meaning: teaches or drills, as a sports coach does

explanation.surface: Getting around by bus or carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Railway carriages pulled by an engine are a means of travel; coaching athletes is instructing them.

clue.text: Remove summary

definitions.meaning: a short précis of a paper

explanation.surface: Take away the synopsis.
explanation.definitionFit: To extract something is to take it away; a précis heading a scientific paper is also so called.

clue.text: Fuel peters out on railway

parts.note: to die away is to peter out
EL is an elevated railway, as in Chicago

explanation.surface: Fuel runs dry on the railway line.
explanation.definitionFit: Diesel is an oil used to power engines.

clue.text: Shake plate with husks of grain on?

indicators.note: the plate has the husks put on it, so the husks are placed ahead of the plate in the answer

parts.note: bran is the husk of cereal grain
a dish is a plate

explanation.surface: Someone waves a dish with cereal husks on it.
explanation.definitionFit: To wave a weapon about threateningly is to flourish it.
